$comment: VAPP-106: the size budgets release/size.ts --check gates (bytes; gzip where a browser downloads it). Every entry of sizes.json has one, a little above the number on record, so a pull request that grows the SDK past it fails exponential-ui.yml; a change that shrinks something lowers its budget in the same commit (the ratchet). Keys: npm = <package>/<entry> (minified, the entry plus the chunks it imports; <package>/styles.css = a web renderer's stylesheet as built, <package>/standalone.js = the element's self-contained file), xcframework/<slice>, android/<abi>, crate/<host>/<artifact>. Doubled per Danny 2026-10-26: budgets were tripping CI on every small change; every budget = 2× its measured size (CI where measured, else sizes.json; the per-machine overrides 2× their measure = budget / 1.025), so the check still fails a real blow-up past 2×. VAPP-160: the entries that import catalog/style.json (eui index, schema, conformance, host, web; the element standalone) lowered by exactly the bytes + gzip that importing generated/style.runtime.json (no `$comment`s) saved, measured before/after on one machine. VAPP-275: the host contract's runtime slice (generated/host.runtime.json, only what src/host/contract.ts and exposes.ts read) replaced the whole catalog/host.json in every entry that imports the host contract: eui index, host and conformance and the element standalone lowered by exactly the bytes + gzip saved (measured before/after on one machine). eui/web gzip raised 50,500 → 54,000 for real renderer code (Markdown, Tabs strip, the inline calendar, the brand icon: 52,516 on master) plus the measured growth of the open round-7 PRs (Sidebar rail +136, foldable Row + Tree +455, anchored + hosted popovers +855).

$machines.$comment: EXP-1371: per build machine overrides (EXPONENTIAL_UI_SIZE_MACHINE). github-macos-26 = GitHub's macos-26 image (the exponential-ui.yml fallback and release-eui.yml), measured on PR #1155 run 39900265032 (+2.5 % like the base budgets).
